summary: Allot Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K comprising interim condensed consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the six months ended June 30, 2026, signed September 9, 2026 by CFO Liat Nahum. The exhibits cover first-half 2026 results, with XBRL tagging referencing the Lynrock Lake Master Fund convertible notes issued February 2022 and registration statements on Forms F-3 and S-8. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation terms appear. This is a routine semi-annual reporting filing; no deal terms, no arbitrage angle, and no event-driven catalyst are presented.
